title: [Pre Order] Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 256GB $749 + $300 GC with JB Mobile $99/M 24-Month Plan (Port-in & in-Store Only) @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 256GB $749 + $300 GC with JB Mobile $99/M 24-Month Plan (Port-in & in-Store Only) @ JB Hi-Fi

[yummypinacolada] Ultra is worse at JB because they only do $1800 off instead of $1950 like in the Fold 8
[BargainsGrabber] Fold8 Ultra only gets $1800 off
They’re promoting more on the Fold8 with $1950 off
So just add OP’s calculation with an additional $150
[bluemyself] I thought they closed the loop hole when doing the account cancelling thing? Or is it you don't save as much as before?
Also, not sure if it's been posted, and I'm too lazy to do it myself, but if you have Commbank yello, there's a possibly targeted deal to get 25% of at the official Samsung store. I think it's for any of the new Galaxy Z devices.
[LalaBanana] From what I've been reading it has been. But hey who are we 😅
[mclachat] Are you sure the ETC is only $950?
Reading the CIS the ETC should be around $1050 (based on 800 base voucher (always offered as part of plan) and up to $300 bonus voucher (only offered during select promotional windows))
[jimojr] It could be a mistake. The terms and conditions clearly state that the ETC is up to $1100 .
[BikerBoy] Love this! Was comparing this and the Optus deal, and with the TRS, this deal makes sense to me (I’m flying early October). Does it need to be a port in or can it be a new sim form JB/ Telstra? I don’t to lose my Belong data, so I was planning on getting a new number if that is eligible.
Big change for me as I’m switching from the Apple ecosystem. Also given the upcoming release of iPhone fold, which is going to be the same aspect ratio as Fold 8, I reckon apps in that size won’t be an issue 😁
[SuHao] But if you preorder now, how could you qualify the “60 days before leaving” condition?
[yummypinacolada] @SuHao: You will get the invoice on the day you pick up not the day you pre-order. I'm flying early October as well, and have confirmed that the tax invoice will be on the day I pick up the phone
[SuHao] @yummypinacolada: Ooooh nice! I’m flying mid October 🎉 thanks mate
[BikerBoy] @yummypinacolada so do you know if we can buy a new number on the spot at JB or does it need to be a port in?
[Fredfloresjr] Be careful, this loop has been closed for ages now as you have to repay the VOUCHER (any discounts) back to them. This is very wrong.
"If you cancel or move to a lower cost/different plan before you have paid 24 monthly instalments then you must pay a Voucher Repayment Fee to Telstra pro-rated against the remaining instalments (or part instalments). You can view the remaining months in your term in the JB Hi-Fi Mobile App, to find out the Voucher Repayment Fee that applies to you, contact 13 50 75, or visit your local JB Hi-Fi Store"
[Fredfloresjr] Only OP did was cancelling it, phone still with JB lol.
Next post: ombudsman or ACCC?
[yummypinacolada] The phone was already paid for yesterday. JB paid 1950 with GC and I paid $750 on top of it.
[soupratt] In regard to TRS, you can claim the GST leaving but you have to declare the item coming back and since its over $1000 you have to pay GST. Am I missing something ?
[leop] How do they know if you don't tell them?
[Dumpshid] You can try your luck. If they random check, you will to pay GST back plus penalty. If you think worth taking a risk then go for it 😆
[soupratt] Well, they know you have applied for a TRS on the way out. And they know it's a phone. You could take your chances on the way back but if they found out you lied on the declaration forms you will earn a bigger fine than anything you can claim,
[0PriceJack0] Shhhh 🤫 You dont have to say if no one ask
[Fredfloresjr] If yah from Melbourne, never do the right thing brooo
[fozzie] Some people travel with family. Then you can bring back $900 per person I believe.
[killingtime] I bought a $3.5k Macbook M5 Pro a month ago. I told them when I came back. They didn't care and didn't bill me.
[tadaaa] The value will also decrease when you declare with them. And the GST will be your phone's decreased value minus 900 (if you travel alone). So, they likely won't bother doing it.
[pgsheng] @yummypinacolada thanks for the post. Did you receive the ETC already right after cancellation? Possible to have a screenshot of what the cancellation invoice from Telstra looks like?
[Chippps] I think people are not always getting the deal as posted with these cancellation fee type deals… It's easy to post a deal and say you have done it. But then when you eventually get charged something different. You're not exactly gonna jump back on here and admit it didn't work.
[SetTheFaqUp] Store dependant. Some JB store "managers" take justice into their own hands and will tell you that you are cheating the system. Refuse to provide the product.
A mate once brought a phone (some years back when their protocol and TnCs were pretty f-d) to the store for return. The manager refuse to give the phone back, or issue a refund for the invoice amount saying that he's cancelled the plan and can't have the phone.
Being someone that went through law school, he gave him the option to hand it back or will call the police. The aftermath was pretty wild too.
[Mjk698] It's crazy how these customer service people take things personally; like it's coming out of their own pockets, who cares if some people make a few bucks of a multi billion dollar company 😆
[SetTheFaqUp] I think it is more so how they twist what is in black and white. I have once returned an iPad from the deal as well. Was much easier back then, but the store people were still doing it as if it is a charity.
Safe to say that JB is doing it to boost their profit and selling the phone at RRP whilst some of the "discounts" as marketing fund.
One way JB could have done it is to fix their system (they did for a while with the increased voucher repayment and only offered GC towards a phone). That probably have tanked their sales on mobile devices (in which was in their quarter result claiming strong mobile sales), and now they are back at it again.
[yummypinacolada] That's abusing the system. Your mate knows that if he didn't buy the phone, the bonus gift card value would be much lower. JB gives a much higher credit on the condition that he buys that specific phone. If you return the phone, you can't expect to keep the same credit value.
The more people who do this, the more likely JB is to change their system like Harvey Norman did—by assigning $0 value to the phone and treating it strictly as a bonus gift
[yummypinacolada] It’s not like people who snag these deals and get them cheaper give me a commission, right? So why did you expect me to admit that it didn't work? I did the deal and posted a screenshot of the invoice. If you try it a week later and JB has changed the terms, that isn't my fault.
I knew lots of tricks and loophole because people are sharing it over Ozb, I took the risks, 99% of the time it works, but when it doesn't I don't blame OP.
[fozzie] @yummypinacolada what did invoice say? How much for the phone? As you mentioned could be a good deal if you can salary sacrifice.
[yummypinacolada] $2699. You get like a preorder receipt. Then you'll get the actual tax invoice with full amount when you pick up the phone.
[fozzie] Nice! That's pretty good! I would go for the 512gb fold, but on the fence as I have a perfectly fine S24 ultra 🤣. First world problem. It would only cost me $200-300 out of pocket if I sold my S24 Ultra (after salary sacrifice and selling my Ultra).
[Mild October] The thumbnail is showing Fold 8 Ultra, as reminder.
[LalaBanana] When it comes to tax les, what the invoice show is irrelevant if what you paid is less. If you get audited the amount on the invoice will need to match up with what comes out of your bank account because they look at both. And if you pay cash then expect to be able to show where the cash came from because a lot of businesses don't claim it.
[Toxinor] Gary's deal is slightly better? Unless anyone still prefers Telstra.
[Roe Jogan] u aint selling the gift card for 270 bro no one is gonna bother with it for 30 dollar saving, 250 maybe
[yummypinacolada] Maybe check classified here how much people have sold JB GC before commenting. Some have sold for less than 10% off.
[paloverde88] wow people still not buying folding phones?
[deepakkumar1983] 14th Aug is the release. Any idea, when this will be ready for collection?
[reece8] so to sign up it needs to be done in person in store, but to then terminate ETC, is that done in person same store too or online / over the phone?
[BikerBoy] I cancelled on the app last year, no need to go in.
[reece8] cool, telstra app? then they just send you a final bill with ETC? do you at least have to pay for 1 month or can cancel immediately same day as purchase and collect phone on release date still?
[l2p10] you paid 99 - hard to get this refunded.
enjoy the data for 3 weeks perhaps?
[yummypinacolada] If you have an active Telstra number in your account, you don't need to pay for the 1st month. But you need to have another number(non-telstra) to port in to.
[reece8] @yummypinacolada: can you clarify what you mean by this? what qualifies as an active telstra number? can easily pick up a non telstra number prepaid to port in to
[yummypinacolada] @reece8: I don't know about prepaid, but if you have an active postpaid number with Telstra, the initial $99 won't be charged. But your ETC will be $1000 instead of $958. So in total you save ~$62
[reece8] @yummypinacolada: gotcha. I meant prepaid number to port in to. I assume after paying termination fee porting out is easy too? is all this done via the official Tesla app?
[yummypinacolada] @reece8: No, it was all done through JB Mobile app. If you wanna keep your number, you get billed for ETC after you port out. Otherwise, you just asked to cancel the number through JB mobile app
[l2p10] @yummypinacolada: Can I ask which section in the JB mobile app?
Just cant seems to find the option. Or it needs to be done through live chat?
[Aamir1612] Which deal is good between jb or harvey?
[yummypinacolada] If you can't make use of the invoice(TRS claim or salary sacrifice), then harvey is cheaper
[ruztynail] Sorry for my ignorance OP. But i just read the t&c for this deal. It says the following:
If you cancel or move to a lower cost/different plan then you must pay a Voucher Repayment Fee to Telstra pro-rated against the remaining months of your plan’s minimum term.
Doesnt that mean you have to pay $99*23 months back? How did they calculate $958 instead? Thats where i am lost. Thanks
[Alarak] If I port in my existing number from superloop, by the time I cancel the plan, will I get a chance to port the number to somewhere else?
[Deal12376] Harvey Norman’s plans are better they are giving away free phones
[yummypinacolada] Yes, if you can't make use of the Invoice, Harvey Norman is cheaper.
